title: Instant crash when opening project manager on macOS
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 54c6cfee0d4ae12d49fb79c18a37f1139dce09b2

### System information

macOS Tahoe (26.3.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M4 Pro - Apple M4 Pro (14 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

After building from current master (commit 54c6cfee0d4ae12d49fb79c18a37f1139dce09b2), running the Godot executable to open the project manager results in an immediate crash with the following log:

### Steps to reproduce

Build from commit 54c6cfee0d4ae12d49fb79c18a37f1139dce09b2.
Then, run the build with no arguments.
